description: This file defines service functions for managing component credentials, including retrieving all credentials, fetching credentials by name, and obtaining credential icons. It exports these functions for use in other parts of the application.

methods.name: getAllComponentsCredentials
methods.description: Retrieves all component credentials from the running Express app, returning a deep clone of each credential.

methods.name: getComponentByName
methods.description: Fetches component credentials by name, supporting multiple names separated by '&'.

methods.name: getSingleComponentsCredentialIcon
methods.description: Returns the icon filepath for a specific component credential if available and valid.
